canada.summary: Conservative candidate David Xie has snatched the Burnaby South-Metrotown riding from NDP incumbent Paul Choi, winning by 64 votes, following the final vote count.

canada.title: Arrest made after poppy donation box stolen in Brandon, Man.
canada.summary: A man was arrested after about $1,000 was stolen from a poppy donation box last week, Brandon police say.

canada.summary: The expense was approved in 2024 and was not questioned until independent journalist Isaac Peltz posted about it on Instagram recently.

canada.title: Honda Canada announces plans to retool Alliston, Ont., plant for hybrid production
canada.summary: Honda Canada says it will retool its manufacturing facilities in Alliston, Ont., to expand production of hybrid-electric and gasoline-powered vehicles. The Japanese automaker announced Monday it is partnering with the federal and provincial governments to fund plant upgrades, including the reintroduction of engine manufacturing, with an initial $166-million investment.

canada.title: Canadian Armed Forces sending nurses to Alberta to help treat CFB Wainwright survivors
canada.summary: The Canadian Armed Forces are sending 15 registered nurses to Alberta to help support the treatment of patients after last month’s fire at CFB Wainwright.

canada.summary: Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. will buy the Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., the automaker announced Monday.

canada.title: Montreal to set up emergency shelter trailers for Notre-Dame encampment this winter
canada.summary: The City of Montreal is hoping residents living in the homeless encampment along Notre-Dame Street E. will move from their tents into a new transition shelter opening on the strip.

canada.title: Thompson will be home to Manitoba's latest Huddle youth support site
canada.summary: A new youth service group — the first of its kind in northern Manitoba — will open in Thompson early next year. The city will soon be home to a Huddle, a group that provides health, education, social supports and other programs.

canada.title: N.L. Housing Corporation to run new transitional housing program
canada.summary: The Newfoundland and Labrador government has cancelled its third request for proposals to replace the Horizons at 106 transitional housing program and will now run its own program.

canada.title: After deaths of 2 brothers, Quebec coroner calls for improvements to REM station fence
canada.summary: A Quebec coroner says the REM light-rail network might have to re-evaluate the penetration-resistant fence around Du Quartier station in Brossard, after two young men were fatally hit by a train there about a year ago.

canada.title: Alberta plans to spend $39M to more than double the number of urgent care centres in province
canada.summary: The Alberta government is putting $39 million over three years toward planning nine new urgent care centres, which it says will ease pressure on crowded emergency rooms and reduce travel times for many patients.

canada.title: ‘Where is the accountability?’: Nunavut’s child advocate says territory’s protection issues aren’t being addressed

canada.title: N.B. has to 'get aggressive,' Holt says as she releases new export strategy
canada.summary: The Holt government announced a plan Monday that aims to boost New Brunswick export markets and increase international export revenue by nearly 16 per cent over the next four years, and by 60 per cent interprovincially.

canada.title: Wekweètì, N.W.T., told to boil drinking water after water pump's 'critical mechanical failure'

bds.h: Could Nvidia survive without its ultra-powerful CEO, Jensen Huang?
bds.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has helmed the company since starting it in 1993, guiding it from a graphics card maker to the AI behemoth it is today. But with an investigation now underway into whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort and no clear successor in sight, analysts say a change at the top — if it were deemed necessary — would be massive.
rows: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
The board of Nvidia said it had no reason to believe that the company's secrets or national security were compromised.
US president says he believes CEO Jensen Huang had no knowledge of woman's alleged work for Chinese intelligence.
